senses.gloss:
इल् इल्, cl. 6. P. इलति, इयेल, एलिष्यति,
ऐलीत्, एलितुम्, or cl. 10. P. इलयति or
एलयति, -यितुम्, aor. ऐलिलत् or ऐलयीत्, to keep
still, not to move; to become quiet; to send, to
cast; to sleep; to move, to go; [a various reading
has the form इऌ: cf. Old Germ. îllu, îllo, for îlju;
Mod. Germ. Eile; Cambro-Brit. il, ‘progress, mo-
tion;’ Gr. ἐλάω]
